name: EntityReach API
description: Four company-data endpoints available to workspaces with activated API access. Owner-created companies:read Bearer keys. Each successful request, including an empty search, consumes one agreed monthly unit. 60 valid requests/minute per workspace; monthly allowance resets at 00:00 UTC on the first day. Failed provider requests refund the monthly unit but count toward the minute limit. Contacts support page and role parameters. Contact discovery never spends email or mobile reveal credits. No batch or idempotency parameters are provided for these company endpoints. Advanced provider REST APIs use separate credentials; EntityReach MCP uses a scoped workspace key with separate activation. Data examples are fictional and abbreviated.
